name: Thanx
oneLiner: Guest engagement platform for restaurant brands: card-linked and app-based loyalty, CRM, marketing automation, first-party web and app ordering, and AI agents (ThanxAI, SegmentAI, RecoveryAI).
bestFor: Emerging and mid-sized multi-unit restaurant brands that want a flexible loyalty program, owned ordering and automated guest marketing.

updates.text: Thanx and Deliverect announced a partnership for integrated first-party ordering and loyalty, with Deliverect supplying order management and Thanx the loyalty, marketing and ordering front end.
Integration with Kea, an AI phone-ordering system, so guests who order by phone can enroll in loyalty and earn points.

Launched RecoveryAI, an AI agent that wins back guests after a bad digital ordering experience, priced on performance (brands pay when a guest returns). Its second AI product after SegmentAI, a natural-language segment builder.

features: Card-linked loyalty that recognizes guests by payment card in store and online
Points, tiers and non-discount rewards (Access Pass: experiences, secret menu items, early access)
Self-serve program changes and offer management
Automated lifecycle campaigns, including winback of lapsed guests
SegmentAI: build guest segments by describing them in plain language
RecoveryAI: AI agent that follows up after a poor digital order
Branded app and Thanx Web first-party ordering
POS and ordering integrations (Toast, Deliverect, Kea phone ordering)

pricing.text: Custom pricing; Thanx does not publish prices. Pricing is based on restaurant count, average unit volume and the capabilities you need (loyalty, CRM, digital ordering, marketing automation); you get a quote after a demo. Thanx only works with companies based in the USA and Canada.

November 2026: thanx.com and thanx.com/pricing fetched directly with curl (pricing model, USA and Canada only, customer quotes). G2 shows only 2 reviews for Thanx (5.0), too few to cite, so no rating.
pros: Card-linked loyalty: guests earn with the payment card they already use, no scanning
Rewards beyond discounts (Access Pass) to protect margin
Loyalty, CRM, marketing automation and first-party ordering share one guest record
AI agents for segments (SegmentAI) and guest recovery (RecoveryAI), with RecoveryAI priced on performance

cons.text: No published prices; quotes depend on restaurant count, unit volume and modules
Only works with companies based in the USA and Canada
Built for emerging and mid-sized multi-unit brands, so a single location may need less than it offers
Focused on loyalty, ordering and guest marketing; review management and listings need another tool

plans.billing: custom quote based on restaurant count, average unit volume and modules
